blocks.text:
Specifications:
Material: PP
Color: Green
Quantity: 2/4 PCS
1. These tree supports are sturdy and reliable, preventing trees from tilting or falling over in harsh weather, so you don't have to worry about damaging new trees.
2. They can correct tree shape early and provide stable support as trees grow until their root systems are strong enough to support themselves independently.
3. The support rings are up to 4 inches in diameter, providing ample growing space for young trees.
4. Flexible rubber straps gently but firmly secure trees without damaging the trunk.
5. Suitable for a variety of trees, shrubs, and tall plants in the garden.
6. Quick installation in minutes, reusable, and environmentally friendly.

items.label: Protect Saplings From Harsh Weather
items.value: Tree supports provide strong support for your trees. Even in stormy weather, you don't need to worry about your trees being blown over

items.label: Help Saplings Grow Straight & Healthy
items.value: Tree supports young trees correct and provide strong support as they grow, ensuring they can grow upright and healthily. It can also support the trunk of newly planted trees, keeping them upright until the root system matures

items.label: 4-inch Growth Space
items.value: The tree straightening kit has a 4-inch diameter circular space (support ring) in the center, enough for saplings to grow and mature. The highly elastic rubber band will not affect the trunk's growth, providing flexible and effective protection

items.label: Durable PP Material
items.value: Our tree holder support is made of more durable, high-strength PP material, suitable for various trees and other similar tall plants. It is environmentally friendly and recyclable

items.label: Easy Installation
items.value: Insert the T-post 10 inches away from the sapling, remove the retaining cap at the end of the tree support and secure it to the post. Place the tree in the support ring, reinstall the removable part, wrap the sapling with rubber bands and secure the ends of the rubber bands to the side clips of the support ring
